questions.question_text: The Proponent shall describe its approach to social procurement, including Indigenous, local and diversity-owned subcontracting.
Who will be the single point of contact for the Authority, and what authority do they have to commit your organization?
Provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The Proponent must describe at least two comparable projects completed in the last five years, including scope, duration and outcome.
The Proponent shall state whether it has an office in Alberta (Yes/No).
The Proponent shall describe the integration options, such as APIs and file transfer, available between the patient scheduling and reminder system and the existing systems of the Authority.
The patient scheduling and reminder system shall keep an audit log of user activity that administrators cannot alter (Yes/No).
The Proponent must describe how the patient scheduling and reminder system scales to support peak loads and growth in the number of users.
The Proponent should describe how double-booking of clinicians and rooms is prevented.
Does the patient scheduling and reminder system send reminders by SMS or email only to patients who have given consent? (Yes/No)
The Proponent should describe how the waitlist is managed and how cancelled appointments are offered to waiting patients.
Please describe how the patient scheduling and reminder system supports the Health Information Act (Alberta), including privacy impact assessment requirements.
Attach a sample Privacy Impact Assessment prepared for a comparable client.
The Proponent shall confirm that all patient information will be stored and processed in Canada (Yes/No).
The Proponent must state whether it holds a current ISO/IEC 27001 certification (Yes/No).
The Proponent shall confirm that the patient scheduling and reminder system will achieve monthly availability of at least 99.9 percent (Yes/No).
Please describe how you comply with the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (Alberta) and any other privacy legislation that applies to patient information.
Describe how administrative access to production systems is controlled and logged.
Describe how security events are monitored and who responds outside business hours.
State whether penetration testing is performed by an independent party. (Yes/No)
Please describe your approach to migrating existing data, including cut-over and rollback.
Please describe your project management methodology and how progress will be reported to the Authority.
The warranty provided, and what it excludes, is to be described.
Please describe your support model, including hours of coverage, escalation paths and target response times.
Please describe your testing approach, including user acceptance testing and who signs off.
The Proponent shall describe how it will support organizational change management and user adoption.
Provide a high-level schedule showing the main phases and their durations.
Identify the tasks that need the participation of staff of the Authority.
Describe how scope changes will be handled during implementation.
Attach a sample status report from a comparable project.
The Proponent should describe the exit and transition assistance available at the end of the contract.
(Optional) Details of the training provided to administrators and end users, including delivery method, duration and materials, are to be included.
(Optional) Does the patient scheduling and reminder system conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA? (Yes/No)
The Proponent must attach its most recent SOC 2 Type II report.
Attach your most recent audited financial statements.
Attach a current Workers' Compensation Board clearance letter.
Describe any annual price escalation proposed for the term of the contract.
Complete the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C, showing all prices in Canadian dollars and excluding GST.
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST

questions.question_text: Please confirm that your prices will be held for 120 days after the Closing Time. (Yes/No)
Provide hourly rates by role for change requests and additional services.
The patient scheduling and reminder system shall provide bulk import of records from CSV files, listing validation errors by row.
The patient scheduling and reminder system shall record every create, update and delete action with the user and time stamp.
The patient scheduling and reminder system shall support full-text search across all records the user is permitted to see.
The patient scheduling and reminder system should allow business users to configure workflow steps without vendor assistance.
The patient scheduling and reminder system shall send an email notification when a workflow step is assigned to a user.
The patient scheduling and reminder system shall retain deleted records for 30 days before permanent removal.
Please describe your support model, including hours of coverage, escalation paths and target response times.
The Proponent should describe the training provided to administrators and end users, including delivery method, duration and materials.
The Proponent shall describe its project management methodology and how progress will be reported to the Authority.
